name: LogicWeft Studio – Class Booking, Front Desk & Day Close for WooCommerce
author: logicweft

sections.description:
LogicWeft Studio turns a WooCommerce site into a studio system: members book classes from your timetable, the front desk runs the day from a tablet, instructors take attendance on a phone, and the owner closes the day with numbers that match WooCommerce.

Every class is a WooCommerce product and every paid booking is a WooCommerce order, so your payment gateways, taxes, coupons, emails and reports keep working, and retail products go in the same cart as a class. There is no monthly platform fee.

Try it first at Lotus & Lift, the live demo studio: book a class as a member, then open the Operator App as the front desk or an instructor. It resets every night.

Features

  • Timetable: class types, instructors, rooms, recurring schedules, one-off classes, substitutes and cancellations, generated ahead in your studio’s timezone (a 7:00 class stays at 7:00 when the clocks change)
  • Online booking of drop-in, free and pay-at-studio classes, with guest booking, booking windows and per-member limits
  • A cancellation policy: members who cancel in time are refunded (through the payment gateway, or marked for you to refund), and later cancellations are recorded as late
  • A safe capacity check: two people can never take the last spot, and a spot in the cart is held for a few minutes
  • Waitlists with automatic promotion and a payment link, or manual promotion at the front desk
  • Member QR codes, QR and name-search check-in, walk-ins and a self check-in kiosk on a tablet
  • The Operator App for the front desk and instructors: Today, class rosters, check-in, timetable, members, waitlists and day close. The desk can take payment or mark a booking as complimentary. It keeps checking people in when the Wi-Fi drops and syncs when it is back
  • Member cards with visit history, notes, health and injury notes, emergency contact and tags
  • WooCommerce emails for confirmations, cancellations, waitlist offers, cancelled classes and reminders, with calendar files
  • Attendance reports by class and instructor, with CSV export
  • Timetable, booking, class list and instructor list blocks, shortcodes and Elementor widgets, and “My classes” in My Account
  • Appearance settings: palette presets, your brand colour, light and dark, bundled fonts
  • A setup wizard and an optional demo studio
  • Privacy tools: personal data export and erasure, suggested privacy policy text, an optional retention rule
  • Translation-ready, with right-to-left support

LogicWeft Studio Pro

A separate paid add-on, sold on logicweft.com, adds recurring-revenue tools: class packs and credits, memberships, renewals, late-cancel and no-show fees, and retention reports. It is not needed for anything this plugin does.

External services

LogicWeft Studio does not send data from your site to any outside service, and it loads no remote scripts, styles, fonts or images. It has no analytics and no update checks.

Google Calendar (link only)

The booking confirmation, My classes and the confirmation email show an “Add to Google Calendar” link. Nothing is sent when a page loads. Only when a member clicks the link, their browser opens calendar.google.com with the class name, start and end time, the studio’s name and address and a short description in the link, so Google can pre-fill a calendar event. The same places also offer a downloadable .ics calendar file, which stays on your site.

  • Google Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Source code and build

The JavaScript and CSS in assets/ are compiled. Their human-readable source ships with the plugin in apps/: the timetable, booking and My classes front end (apps/booking), the Operator App, kiosk and service worker (apps/operator), the admin timetable and settings screens (apps/admin), the shared stylesheets (apps/ui) and the shared Operator App shell, components and design tokens (apps/wc-ops-core-ui), written in TypeScript and React.

To rebuild assets/ from that source, use Node.js 20 or newer and pnpm 9 or newer in the plugin folder:

pnpm install && pnpm build

The build uses Vite, TypeScript and React, as listed in the package.json files. React itself is not bundled: the apps use the copy that ships with WordPress. The PHP code is not compiled. The shared operations library it uses ships as readable PHP in vendor-prefixed/ (GPL-2.0-or-later), namespaced under LogicWeft\Studio\Vendor so it never clashes with other plugins.

Third-party libraries

Everything bundled is GPL-compatible. The licence texts are in the plugin’s licenses/ folder.

  • wc-ops-core, LogicWeft’s shared WooCommerce operations library (GPLv2 or later, by the same author). PHP in vendor-prefixed/ under the LogicWeft\Studio\Vendor namespace, so it cannot clash with another plugin’s copy; its UI source in apps/wc-ops-core-ui.
  • QR code encoder for member QR codes, from LogicWeft Salon (GPLv2 or later, LogicWeft’s own code), in src/Qr/.
  • qr by Paul Miller, the QR decoder used by the check-in camera when the browser has no built-in barcode reader (MIT, chosen from MIT or Apache-2.0), compiled into the Operator App.
  • Workbox 7 (MIT) with idb (ISC), in the Operator App’s service worker.
  • Inter and Manrope variable fonts (SIL Open Font License 1.1), packaged by Fontsource and bundled, so no font is loaded from another site.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce 9.5 or later.
  2. Install LogicWeft Studio from Plugins → Add New, or upload the zip under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, and activate it.
  3. Open Studio in the admin menu and follow the setup steps: studio details, classes, instructors and the weekly timetable. You can add a demo studio to try everything first.
  4. Add the Timetable block (or the [lwstudio_timetable] shortcode) to a page. The front desk opens the Operator App at yoursite.com/studio-app/ on a tablet.
sections.faq:
Can I try it before installing?

Yes. Lotus & Lift is a live demo studio running this plugin. Book any class (no payment is taken and no email is sent), then log in at /studio-app/ as demo-owner, demo-desk or demo-instructor (the password is the same as the username) to see the Operator App. The demo also runs LogicWeft Studio Pro, so it shows class packs and memberships too; everything else is in this free plugin. It resets every night.

Does it need WooCommerce?

Yes. Classes are WooCommerce products and paid bookings are WooCommerce orders, so WooCommerce 9.5 or later must be active.

Can members book without an account?

Yes. Guests book with a name and email; members with an account also see their classes, waitlist places and QR code under My Account → My classes.

What happens when two people book the last spot at the same moment?

Only one of them gets it. Every booking, online or at the desk, takes its spot in a single database transaction, and the other person is offered the waitlist.

Does it work with the Cart and Checkout blocks and HPOS?

Yes, both, as well as the classic cart and checkout.

Does the Operator App work offline?

Check-ins made while the connection is down are kept on the device and sent when it is back, marked “pending sync” until then. Bookings are never taken offline, so a class cannot be overbooked.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. The timetable and booking widget inherit your theme’s fonts by default and size themselves to their container. The Operator App and the kiosk have their own full-screen pages.

Where is member data stored?

In your own WordPress database. Nothing is sent to LogicWeft or anyone else. Health questions are off by default, and members’ data can be exported and erased with the WordPress privacy tools.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First public release.
  • Timetable: class products, instructors, rooms, recurring schedules generated in the studio’s timezone, one-off classes, substitutes and cancellations, with a week grid in the admin.
  • Booking: drop-in, free and pay-at-studio classes, guest booking, held spots in the cart, booking and cancellation windows, per-member limits, and a capacity check that never overbooks.
  • Waitlists with automatic promotion and a payment link, and manual promotion at the desk.
  • WooCommerce integration: Cart and Checkout blocks, classic checkout, HPOS, order status sync, refunds when the studio cancels a class, and five booking emails with calendar files.
  • Customer front end: timetable, class sheet, booking flow and My classes with the member QR code, as blocks, shortcodes and Elementor widgets; appearance settings with palette presets and bundled fonts.
  • Operator App for the front desk and instructors: Today, rosters, check-in by QR or name, walk-ins, timetable, members, My classes, day close, and offline check-in.
  • Self check-in kiosk with device pairing and a staff PIN to exit.
  • Setup wizard, optional demo studio and WP-CLI demo commands.
  • Attendance reports by class and instructor, with CSV export.
  • Privacy: personal data exporters and erasers, suggested policy text and an optional retention rule.
  • Translation template and right-to-left support.

screenshots.caption: The class timetable on a phone: a week strip, today's classes and the spots left in each.
The same timetable on a desktop, with filters by class, instructor and level.
The class sheet: time, room, instructor, what to bring and the book button.
My classes in My Account: upcoming classes with cancel and add to calendar, and the member QR code.
The Operator App's Today screen on a tablet: every class of the day with bookings, check-ins and waitlists.
A class roster at the front desk: check people in, add walk-ins and promote from the waitlist.
Checking in while the Wi-Fi is down: the check-in is kept on the tablet and marked pending sync.
The self check-in kiosk: members scan their QR code or enter their phone number.
The admin timetable: the week as a grid, with recurring and one-off classes.
Settings: booking, cancellation and waitlist rules, each with its default.
